event: Initial direct HiGHS dual-simplex and IPM, and 128-row adaptive IPM, exceeded 90-second limits. Adaptive bound reached 0.349281 versus published rounded objective 0.3510 but remained infeasible (0.02067 Gy max violation). No candidate accepted.

Warm-start incremental separation solved published baseline in 16.4 seconds and passed independent evaluation. Cold adaptive and direct timing observations were not controlled A/A comparisons. Full enumeration started; uniform baseline independently rejected.
